description: Iowa Medicaid covers eligible residents through several pathways. The Iowa Health and Wellness Plan is the adult coverage pathway for qualifying people ages 19–64.
introduction: Iowa Medicaid covers eligible residents through several pathways. The Iowa Health and Wellness Plan is the adult coverage pathway for qualifying people ages 19–64.

sections.who: HHS determines the appropriate Medicaid category. The Health and Wellness Plan has income and residency rules and is for adults not otherwise eligible for Medicaid or Medicare.
sections.get: Coverage includes medical care, prescriptions, mental health services and dental care. Health and Wellness Plan members may owe contributions after the first year unless applicable healthy-behavior steps are completed.
sections.docs: Have family income, existing health-insurance details, and applicants’ Social Security numbers or immigration document numbers available.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through the Iowa HHS Services Portal, a local HHS office or a participating health center. Telephone applications: 855-889-7985.

  2. Submit any requested evidence and read the eligibility decision before making plan choices.
sections.after: Approved applicants receive Medicaid and enrollment information. Check the assigned medical/dental plan, choice deadline and coverage date. As of October 2026, HHS announces community-engagement requirements for certain adult-plan members beginning by December 1, 2026; read notices for your circumstances.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: Medicaid application, Health and Wellness Plan.

Historical screenshots and background: USA Assistance. Screenshots may show an earlier application interface.

faqs: Is submitting an application the same as selecting a plan?
No. Eligibility is decided first; enrollment information follows.
Are the December rules already in effect in October?
The state announces a December 2026 start. Follow dated HHS notices.
Does every Medicaid member use the adult Wellness Plan?
No. Medicaid has several eligibility categories.
